parsed_json.up: Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback doi), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (target_dictionary.organism). Join molecule_dictionary -> compound_records on molregno -> docs on record_id -> activities on record_id -> assays on assay_id -> target_dictionary on tid. Inner join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, and (docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL). Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
